notes.text:
The cover identifies the booklet as ‘A Colonial Thing’, compiled by Joy Slappnig and Claudia Augustat. MoSA examined it as a lead for reconciling the `anzuelo-piedra-viena` row in arte-en-la-cultura-rapanui. On PDF page 10 (viewer page index 9), the booklet reproduces a 1958 letter from Fritz Felbermayer to museum employee Irmgard Moschner. The quoted letter says Felbermayer would personally transport a rare stone fish hook to Vienna. This future-tense statement documents intention, not completed receipt or identity with the Arte en la cultura rapanui table entry. No object identity or custody claim is made here, so no object link or claim is supported.

Retrieval checked 30 September 2026: the museum’s direct PDF URL returned a 404 Not Found page in MoSA’s isolated browser capture. That error page was not registered. The indexed PDF text remained readable through the web PDF viewer, but no original PDF bytes were captured. A read-only Wayback availability check returned 404; a CDX check was unavailable while Internet Archive services reported temporarily offline. No existing archive snapshot could be confirmed.
